cases.name: plain-book
cases.covers: A complete book in a folder, plus a book that has no sources folder at all.

cases.name: empty-folder
cases.covers: Folder directories holding no book, including a nested one, are still folders.

cases.name: dangling-current-source
cases.covers: current_source and cover both name files that are gone; the reader falls back to the newest source.

cases.name: legacy-schema
cases.covers: A book.json and a source meta.json written before schema versioning.

cases.name: future-schema
cases.covers: A book.json written by a newer build: readable, carries an unknown field, refuses writes.

cases.name: ignored-dirs
cases.covers: System directories (@eaDir, .stfolder, #recycle, $RECYCLE.BIN, lost+found) are neither folders nor book containers.

cases.name: html-characters
cases.covers: Titles, authors, tags, a source comment and a folder name carrying &, <, > and quotes, written as themselves rather than as \u escapes.

cases.name: multi-writer-cache
cases.covers: Several app/book-cache-*.json files, two of which this build cannot use.

cases.name: source-assets
cases.covers: A source whose illustrations live in assets/ and are referenced by relative path.

cases.name: shelf-config-ignore
cases.covers: A shelf.json that replaces the scanner's ignore list: the names it gives are skipped case-insensitively, an entry may carry the reason it is there, entries that are unusable, of the wrong type, or written as a bare name are dropped one by one, and a built-in name the list omits is listed as an ordinary folder.

cases.name: v1-frozen-at-1.0.0-rc
cases.covers: The frozen baseline: a book.json carrying every field schema v1 defines and a source meta.json carrying every field its schema v1 defines, both read at the values 1.0.0-rc froze. Its shelf tree is append-only from that release on.
